title: The Hawaiian Conveyor Belt
hook: Your fingernails grow at the same speed the Hawaiian Islands move.
script: Your fingernails grow at the same speed the Hawaiian Islands move. This happens because the Pacific Plate carries the archipelago northwest about 7 centimetres a year. What if you waited on Hawaii long enough? You would eventually drift into the Japan Trench and sink into the mantle. The islands are actually a conveyor belt of volcanoes moving over a fixed hotspot. This blowtorch of magma creates a trail of seamounts extending 6,000 kilometres across the ocean floor. It is a slow, one-way trip toward the horizon, at the same speed your fingernails grow.
